mayRequireContentKeysForMediaDataProcess.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether you can add this asset as a content key recipient to a content key session.

mediaExtensionProperties.doc: The properties of the media extension format reader that decodes the asset.

resourceLoader.doc: The resource loader for the asset.

sidecarURL.doc: The sidecar URL used by the MediaExtension.

variants.doc: An array of variants that an asset contains.

AVVideoComposition.Configuration.doc: Configurable properties for initializing a new AVVideoComposition instance.

AVVideoCompositionPerFrameHDRDisplayMeta.doc: A type that defines the policy for handling of per frame HDR metadata.

animationTool.doc: A video composition tool to use with Core Animation in offline rendering.

colorPrimaries.doc: The color primaries used for video composition.

colorTransferFunction.doc: The transfer function used for video composition.

colorYCbCrMatrix.doc: The YCbCr matrix used for video composition.

customVideoCompositorClass.doc: A custom compositor class to use.

frameDuration.doc: A time interval for which the video composition should render composed video frames.

init(applyingFiltersTo:applier:).doc: Creates a video composition configured to apply Core Image filters to each video frame of the specified asset.

init(configuration:).doc: Initialize an AVVideoComposition with a configuration.

outputBufferDescription.doc: The output buffers of the video composition can be specified with the outputBufferDescription. The value is an array of CMTagCollectionRef objects that describes the output buffers.

perFrameHDRDisplayMetadataPolicy.doc: The policy for display of HDR display metadata on the rendered frame.

renderScale.doc: The scale at which the video composition should render.

renderSize.doc: The size at which the video composition should render.

sourceSampleDataTrackIDs.doc: The identifiers of source sample data tracks in the composition that the compositor requires to compose frames.

sourceTrackIDForFrameTiming.doc: An identifier of the source track from which the video composition derives frame timing.

spatialVideoConfigurations.doc: Indicates the spatial configurations that are available to associate with the output of the video composition.

AVVideoCompositionCoreAnimationTool.Conf.doc: Configurable properties for initializing a new AVVideoCompositionCoreAnimationTool instance.

init(configuration:).doc: Compose the composited video frames with the Core Animation layer.

AVVideoCompositionLayerInstruction.Confi.doc: Configurable properties for initializing a new AVVideoCompositionLayerInstruction instance.

cropRectangleRamp(at:).doc: Obtains the crop rectangle ramp that includes the specified time.

init(configuration:).doc: Initialize an AVVideoCompositionLayerInstruction with a configuration.

opacityRamp(at:).doc: Obtains the opacity ramp that includes a specified time.

trackID.doc: The track identifier of the source track to which the compositor will apply the instruction.

transformRamp(at:).doc: Obtains the transform ramp that includes a specified time.

edgeWidths.doc: The width of the edge processing region on the left, top, right, and bottom edges, in pixels.

makeMutablePixelBuffer().doc: Vends a CVMutablePixelBuffer to use for rendering. The buffer will have its kCVImageBufferCleanApertureKey and kCVImageBufferPixelAspectRatioKey attachments set to match the current composition processor properties.

pixelAspectRatio.doc: The pixel aspect ratio for rendered frames.

renderScale.doc: A scaling ratio that is applied when rendering frames.

renderTransform.doc: A transform to apply to the source image.

size.doc: The width and height for the rendering frames.

endCompositionTime.doc: The end time of the upcoming composition requests.

startCompositionTime.doc: The start time of the upcoming composition requests.

numberOfCorruptedFrames.doc: The total number of corrupted frames.

numberOfDroppedFrames.doc: The total number of frames the system drops prior to decoding or from missing the display deadline.

numberOfFramesDisplayedUsingOptimizedCom.doc: The total number of full screen frames rendered in a special power-efficient mode that didn’t require compositing with other UI elements.

totalAccumulatedFrameDelay.doc: The accumulated amount of time between the prescribed presentation times of displayed video frames and their actual time of display.

totalNumberOfFrames.doc: The total number of frames that display if no frames drop.
